summary.value: New York Marriott Downtown sits at 85 West Street at Albany Street, New York, New York, USA, 10006, near the Statue of Liberty ferries and the Financial District. It suits travelers centering their trip downtown, and the New York Marriott Downtown – home to Bill’s Bar & Burger, renowned for serving some of the best burgers in the country adds live music, inventive cocktails and a selection of regional beers at its bar. Trip.com guests rate it 8.6 / 10 Very good 342 reviews and say “Safe and good location. Loved the great river view and is very clean”; the watch-out is room size: “The room was tiny, and the bed was also very small”.
